title: PullLeaseProtocol
description: Discriminated-union schema for all messages exchanged on the pull-lease channel between worker and orchestrator.

PullJobRequest.title: PullJobRequest
PullJobRequest.description: Sent by a worker to request the next available job from the orchestrator.

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the requesting worker.

lastSeenAttemptId.description: The attemptId of the last job the worker saw; used by the orchestrator for reconciliation. Null on first pull.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the worker sent this request.

NoJobAvailable.title: NoJobAvailable
NoJobAvailable.description: Sent by the orchestrator when no suitable job is currently available for the requesting worker.

retryAfterMs.description: Number of milliseconds the worker should wait before sending another PullJobRequest.

LeaseGranted.title: LeaseGranted
LeaseGranted.description: Sent by the orchestrator to assign a job lease to the requesting worker.

runId.description: Identifier of the run this lease is for.

attemptId.description: Identifier of this specific attempt within the run.

artifactUrl.description: URL from which the worker must download the automation artifact.

artifactDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the artifact in the format sha256:<64 hex chars>. Worker must verify before execution.

leaseDurationMs.description: Duration of the lease in milliseconds. Worker must renew via Heartbeat before expiry.

jobSchemaVersion.description: Schema version of the job artifact (e.g. '1.0').

LeaseAccepted.title: LeaseAccepted
LeaseAccepted.description: Sent by the worker to confirm receipt and acceptance of a LeaseGranted message.

leaseId.description: The lease identifier from the corresponding LeaseGranted message.

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the worker accepting the lease.

acceptedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the worker accepted the lease.

Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
Heartbeat.description: Sent periodically by the worker to renew its lease and report current execution status.

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the worker sending the heartbeat.

sequenceNumber.description: Monotonically increasing counter for this lease's heartbeat sequence. Starts at 0.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which this heartbeat was sent.

currentStepId.description: Identifier of the step currently executing, or null if between steps or not yet started.

currentRunState.description: The run state as known by the worker at the time of this heartbeat.

HeartbeatAck.title: HeartbeatAck
HeartbeatAck.description: Sent by the orchestrator to acknowledge a Heartbeat and optionally signal cancellation.

sequenceNumber.description: Echo of the sequenceNumber from the Heartbeat being acknowledged.

cancellationRequested.description: When true, the orchestrator is requesting the worker cancel the current run gracefully.

FinalResult.title: FinalResult
FinalResult.description: Sent by the worker when the run has reached a terminal state. Carries the full run result.

leaseId.description: The lease identifier this result closes.

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the worker reporting the result.

CancelRequest.title: CancelRequest
CancelRequest.description: Sent by the orchestrator (or relayed from an external cancellation source) to request cancellation of an active run.

leaseId.description: The lease identifier of the run to be cancelled.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the cancellation was requested.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the cancellation, or null if not provided.

ReconcileRequest.title: ReconcileRequest
ReconcileRequest.description: Sent by the worker when it needs the orchestrator to determine the authoritative disposition of a run (e.g. after connectivity loss or uncertainty about commit status).

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the worker requesting reconciliation.

lastKnownStepId.description: The last step identifier the worker had observed, or null if no step was reached.

lastKnownRunState.description: The last run state the worker had observed, or null if unknown.

ReconcileResponse.title: ReconcileResponse
ReconcileResponse.description: Sent by the orchestrator in response to a ReconcileRequest, providing the authoritative disposition.

disposition.description: The orchestrator's authoritative reconciliation verdict for this lease.

finalRunState.description: The definitive terminal run state if known, or null when disposition is Unknown.

RunResult.title: RunResult
RunResult.description: The final outcome of a run attempt, carried inside FinalResult.

needsAttention.description: True when the run terminated in Unknown or in a Failed state that requires operator review. Per C3: always true when runState=Unknown.

unknownReason.description: Stable string describing what could not be confirmed. Populated when runState=Unknown. Per C3 decision.

errorCategory.description: Category of the error that caused the run to fail, if applicable.

errorDetail.description: Stable detail code for the error (e.g. 'action.executionTimeout', 'action.commitUncertain'). Per C3 decision.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution began.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run reached its terminal state.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds, measured with a monotonic clock. Per REF-10.

outputs.description: Key/value map of declared output values. Sensitive outputs must be redacted per evidence classification rules.

stepResults.description: Ordered list of step result records for this run attempt.

StepResult.title: StepResult
StepResult.description: The outcome of a single step execution within a run.

stepId.description: Identifier of the step as declared in the automation script.

errorCategory.description: Error category if this step failed.

errorDetail.description: Stable detail code for the step error.

needsAttention.description: True when this step terminated in Unknown or requires operator review. Per C3 decision.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this step began execution.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this step reached its terminal state.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of this step in milliseconds, measured with a monotonic clock.

outputs.description: Key/value map of this step's output values.
